title: How to Remove the Post Publish Date
text:
## How to Remove the Post Publish Date
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000101601
Every post is published with the Post Date visible on the website:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149897343/original/sV_zEeYZS3-Ak3fR7aBMc2TPWna9DeqkHw.png?1727139420 | alt: ]

## Remove Date Sitewide
The " Posted " date can be removed site wide by adding this Custom CSS code in Design Settings.
Add the code in the Design Settings:
Go to Settings .
Click on Design Settings .
Head to the Custom CSS / HEAD tab .
Add the code in the Additional CSS space.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149896508/original/QQw_1VySvsBXasAw7NgRAARm_Mq_tNcBVg.png?1727137106 | alt: ]

## Remove Date Individual Post Types
To remove the date for a specific post type add it in the Post Settings.
Go to:
Go to My Content.
Click on Edit Post Settings.
Find to the Post Type .
Head to the Detail Page Design tab.
Add the code in the Insert Additional Code space.
With this one, add the style tags as well:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149883369/original/h81U3TQ2p64GpXOiImsL-yftYjda3uVGTA.png?1727120506 | alt: ]

## Date Removed
Once the code has been saved, the date is removed:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149897346/original/MqlSZ4dVFZNl9AnAQMkg-IOrVTd6eddEfA.png?1727139450 | alt: ]
